method.witness_a: Pinned Hindi Wikisource page transcription projected to Devanagari characters after deterministic layout-markup removal.
method.witness_b: Edition-matched Internet Archive coordinate OCR projected to Devanagari characters.
method.control: All 813 Wikisource quality 3 or 4 narrative pages.
method.screen: A q1 page is inside the descriptive control envelope when both sequence similarity and character-length ratio meet the quality-3/4 fifth-percentile thresholds.
method.claim_boundary: The screen detects unusual witness divergence. It cannot prove exactness, correct shared errors, or substitute for linguistic review.

manual_adjudication.finding: IA OCR drops lower commentary; the q1 transcription still contains visible character and word errors.
IA OCR omits lines; the q1 transcription also contains visible corruptions and a broken line sequence.
Dense noisy print produces divergent errors in both witnesses; neither is safe as consumer text without correction.
The skewed scan causes severe IA OCR truncation; the more complete q1 transcription still contains malformed and omitted text.
Character counts agree but both witnesses retain visible corruptions; similarity alone would conceal consumer-facing errors.

correction_witness_leads.observed_scope: Complete structured Devanagari reading corpus across seven kandas.
All seven Ramcharitmanas kandas in volunteer-prepared electronic formats.

local_ocr_candidate_benchmark.candidate: PaddleOCR dedicated Devanagari PP-OCRv5 mobile recognizer
local_ocr_candidate_benchmark.failure_boundary: Both official detector variants failed in the Windows oneDNN execution path before any recognized text was emitted.

product_boundary.next_required_step: Build a source-range-addressed Hindi/English daily-reading synthesis from corrected or independently reconciled text, and use manual adjudication only for unusual witness divergences.
